question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Day I Stopped Drinking Milk’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sudha Murty.__**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Day I Stopped Drinking Milk **by **Sudha Murty** is a collection of short stories featuring life stories of people the author encountered in her life over the years.
 
• This book has valuable life lessons taken from the life experiences of ordinary people that will appeal to readers looking for moral stories in daily life.
 
• **She shares her experiences at different times and with different people in the form of short stories which are enlightening as well as an eye opener.**
 
• Here also she talks of different situations and gives us her own perspective on her experiences.
